title: Yaakov Karcha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 139b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.139b.19), [Chullin 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.22b.6): 'Yaakov Karcha taught'; and in [Eruvin 86a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.86a.15): Abaye said, 'Yaakov Karchinaah taught' (and in Dikdukei Soferim, 'Karcha').[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2138&lang=en) also records Karcha in Shabbat and Chullin beside Karchinaah in Eruvin. Hyman’s apparatus report is keyed to the printed abbreviation דק״ם.
